responses.text: {Angry Disappointment} We're heading back home. I hope our troops do the same. This land can't be saved.
{Sorrowful} Trying to grow crops in this heat, with so little water, is bad enough, but now we've got radiation seeping into the farmlands east of New Vegas.
{Angry Disappointment} We're done. Let the people of these hell-hole deal with their problems, I say.
